search_queries: targeted PyPI and project-documentation lookups for nine named XML parsers
uncertainty: This is a one-parser pilot, not a completed registry search or top-ten claim. Nine named leads were inspected from PyPI/project documentation; the bounded PyPI Simple Index search remains pending. Eight third-party leads lack pinned control checks. The standard API inventory currently verifies ElementTree only; Expat, DOM and SAX API paths remain documented leads. xmltodict and ElementTree share the Expat syntax engine. The valid control exercises a common XML 1.0 subset, not full XML 1.0 conformance. PyPI Stats package downloads are not XML-specific use.
